subject: radiology
title: FDG PET CT, Superscan and Thyroid Scintigraphy

steps.title: FDG traps inside hungry cells
steps.tx: **FDG PET CT** injects fluorodeoxyglucose, a glucose analogue that glucose transporters import and hexokinase phosphorylates into a trapped product the cell cannot metabolise further. Tumours overexpress those transporters and that enzyme, the Warburg effect, so they glow against quieter background after a sixty minute uptake rest. Standardised uptake value compares lesion concentration with injected dose per body weight, a number for follow up rather than a cancer meter.
steps.say: FDG PET injects a glucose analogue that transporters import and hexokinase traps inside cells. Tumours overexpress both, so they glow after a sixty minute uptake rest. Standardised uptake value compares lesion concentration with dose per body weight, a follow up number rather than a cancer meter.

steps.title: Physiological uptake traps readers
steps.tx: **Physiological FDG uptake** lights brain cortex, myocardium variably, urinary tract excretion, bowel, muscle after exertion or insulin, brown fat in cold young necks and healing inflammation, each a false positive factory. Fasting, warmth and quiet rest tame muscle and brown fat, while infection and post treatment inflammation stay honestly hot for weeks. A new glow after radiotherapy therefore waits twelve weeks before anyone calls it recurrence on PET alone.
steps.say: Physiological FDG uptake lights brain, urinary tract, bowel, exercised muscle, brown fat and healing inflammation, each a false positive factory. Fasting, warmth and rest tame muscle and brown fat. A new glow after radiotherapy waits twelve weeks before anyone calls it recurrence on PET alone.

steps.title: PET stages and restages cancer
steps.tx: **Oncologic PET** earns its cost by finding occult metastases that cancel futile surgery, mapping lymphoma stage and response with Deauville scores, and hunting an unknown primary in neck nodes. It misses subcentimetre lesions, mucinous and signet tumours, many prostate and hepatocellular cancers and hyperglycaemia masked uptake, so a negative PET never sterilises a suspicious CT mass. Glucose above roughly 200 milligrams per decilitre on the day degrades tumour contrast by competition.
steps.say: Oncologic PET finds occult metastases that cancel futile surgery and maps lymphoma response. It misses subcentimetre lesions, mucinous tumours, many prostate and liver cancers and hyperglycaemia masked uptake. Glucose above roughly two hundred on the day degrades tumour contrast by competition.

steps.title: Superscan on MDP bone imaging
steps.tx: **Superscan** washes the whole skeleton uniformly and intensely hot with faint or absent kidney activity on a technetium MDP bone scan, because diffuse prostate or breast metastases, or metabolic hyperparathyroid bone, drink the entire tracer dose. The trap is its beauty: symmetric perfection reads normal to the hurried eye. Checking for missing kidneys and comparing skull and limb intensity with a normal study exposes the pattern before it is signed off as clean.

Its symmetric perfection reads normal to the hurried eye. Checking for missing kidneys exposes the pattern before it is signed off clean.

steps.title: Thyroid scintigraphy sorts nodules
steps.tx: **Thyroid scintigraphy** with technetium pertechnetate or iodine 123 maps trapping function: a hot nodule that suppresses the rest of the gland is almost never malignant and needs no cytology, while a cold nodule carries a meaningful cancer risk and earns ultrasound guided sampling. Whole gland increased uptake with high vascularity fits Graves disease, patchy uptake fits multinodular goitre, and a near absent gland with neck pain fits destructive thyroiditis releasing stored hormone.
steps.say: Thyroid scintigraphy maps trapping function: a hot nodule suppressing the gland is almost never malignant, while a cold nodule earns ultrasound guided sampling. Diffusely increased uptake fits Graves disease, and a near absent gland with neck pain fits destructive thyroiditis.

steps.title: PSMA and DOTATATE extend PET
steps.tx: **PSMA PET** targets prostate specific membrane antigen with gallium 68 or fluorine 18 ligands, finding prostate cancer recurrence at hormone levels where conventional imaging is blind and selecting patients for lutetium PSMA therapy. DOTATATE PET does the same theranostic trick for somatostatin receptor neuroendocrine tumours, staging them and licensing peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. The scan therefore writes the prescription, the defining nuclear medicine idea of this decade.

DOTATATE PET does the same theranostic trick for neuroendocrine tumours. The scan therefore writes the prescription, the defining nuclear medicine idea of this decade.

steps.title: Gallium and infection imaging
steps.tx: **Gallium 67** was the old fever and lymphoma tracer, slow over days and largely retired by FDG PET, while labelled white cell scans still hunt prosthetic joint and vascular graft infection where PET availability or specificity falters. Meckel scans use plain pertechnetate because ectopic gastric mucosa traps it like stomach, lighting a right lower quadrant focus in a bleeding child. Each tracer choice is physiology first, isotope second, the module in one sentence.

steps.title: Reporting uptake with respect
steps.tx: **SUV reporting** quotes maximum standardised uptake value with glucose, uptake time and dose recorded, because a value without its conditions cannot be compared at follow up. Deauville five point scoring in lymphoma instead compares node uptake with mediastinal blood pool and liver, freeing the read from absolute numbers. Both systems exist to stop impressionistic hot or not reporting, and examiners reward the named scale over adjectives every time.
